article.headline: Prince has career-high 35 points as No. 25 Nebraska women roll past Kansas 105-73
article.description: — Britt Prince scored a career-high 35 points, and No. 25 Nebraska raced to a 105-73 win over Kansas in the second game of the MarketBeat Invitational.
article.linkText: Prince has career-high 35 points as No. 25 Nebraska women roll past Kansas 105-73
article.story: SIOUX FALLS, S.D. -- — Britt Prince scored a career-high 35 points, and No. 25 Nebraska raced to a 105-73 win over Kansas in the second game of the MarketBeat Invitational. Natalie Potts added 19 points for the Cornhuskers (4-0), who got 3-pointers from Logan Nissley to end the first quarter and start the second as part of a 13-0 run that produced a 38-20 lead. Jaliya Davis scored 21 points for the Jayhawks (3-1). Libby Fandel added 17, and S'Mya Nichols had 12. Prince was 12-of-18 shooting, going 2 for 6 on 3-pointers, and made all nine of her free throws for her third career 30-point game. Kansas shot 57% (27 of 47) but was outrebounded by 10 on offensive rebounds and had 24 turnovers, so the Cornhuskers put up 25 more shots, making 39 of 72 (54%). Nebraska scored 39 points off turnovers and had 18 second-chance points. Up next Nebraska: Home against Mount St. Mary's on Tuesday.
